evals.prompt: Run a security audit of this repository.
evals.expected_output: SQL injection at app.py:5 (CWE-89) and a hardcoded API key at config.py:1, value never shown; the parameterized query is not a finding; report in security-audit.md with scanners and assurance; source untouched.

evals.prompt: Run a security audit of this repository.
evals.expected_output: No CRITICAL or HIGH finding; the found-nothing line matches the assurance; source untouched.

evals.prompt: Run a quick security audit: security-audit quick.
evals.expected_output: Quick level: prints the report instead of writing it; CRITICAL and HIGH only; finds the SQL injection and the hardcoded key without printing it.

evals.prompt: Audit only api/ with security-audit api/ --report.
evals.expected_output: Writes security-audit.md scoped to api/: the SQL injection in api/users.py; nothing reported from admin/.

evals.prompt: Run a deep security audit: security-audit deep.
evals.expected_output: Writes security-audit.md with an Investigate section; finds the SQL injection; the pickle load is a finding or an investigate item, not ignored.
